#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

long module = 1000000007;

int evaluateOverlap(int a, int b, int startIdx, int endIdx, const vector<char>& patternChars) {
    int segmentCount = 3;
    int segmentSize = a + b;
    vector<char> buffer(segmentCount * segmentSize);
    for (int segmentIdx = 0; segmentIdx < segmentCount; ++segmentIdx) {
        // Collect distinct chars for the segment
        vector<bool> usedLetters(26, false);
        int baseIdx = segmentIdx * segmentSize;
        int startCollect = baseIdx - 1;
        int countCollect = a;
        for (int f = startCollect; f >= 0 && f >= startCollect - countCollect + 1; --f) {
            usedLetters[buffer[f] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        // Fill buffer with distinct chars
        int cr = 0;
        char chPointer = 'a';
        while (cr < a) {
            while (usedLetters[chPointer - 'a']) chPointer++;
            buffer[baseIdx + cr] = chPointer++;
            cr++;
        }
        // Fill the rest with pattern character
        for (int fillIdx = baseIdx + a; fillIdx < baseIdx + segmentSize; ++fillIdx) {
            buffer[fillIdx] = patternChars[segmentIdx];
        }
    }

    int offset = startIdx % segmentSize;
    int length = endIdx - startIdx + 1;
    vector<char> subBuffer(buffer.begin() + offset, buffer.begin() + offset + min((int)buffer.size() - offset, length));

    vector<bool> visited(26, false);
    for (char c : subBuffer) {
        visited[c - 'a'] = true;
    }

    int countTypes = 0;
    for (bool v : visited) {
        if (v) countTypes++;
    }
    return countTypes;
}

vector<char> collectDistinctChars(const vector<char>& arr, int idx, int count) {
    vector<bool> usedLetters(26, false);
    for (int f = idx - 1; f >= 0 && f >= idx - count; --f) {
        usedLetters[arr[f] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    vector<char> res;
    char chPointer = 'a';
    int cr = 0;
    while (cr < count) {
        while (usedLetters[chPointer - 'a']) chPointer++;
        res.push_back(chPointer++);
        cr++;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int aCount, bCount, fromIndex, toIndex;
    cin >> aCount >> bCount >> fromIndex >> toIndex;
    fromIndex--; // zero-based index
    toIndex--;   // zero-based index
    int segmentRange = toIndex - fromIndex + 1;
    int minimumSum = segmentRange;

    for (char c1 = 'a'; c1 <= 'z'; ++c1)
        for (char c2 = 'a'; c2 <= 'z'; ++c2)
            for (char c3 = 'a'; c3 <= 'z'; ++c3) {
                vector<char> patternChars = {c1, c2, c3};
                minimumSum = min(minimumSum, evaluateOverlap(aCount, bCount, fromIndex, toIndex, patternChars));
            }

    cout << minimumSum << "\n";
    return 0;
}
